audit.why: Arcanopulse (Q, 750 range) and Eye of Destruction (W) out-range Maokai's entire kit; Shocking Orb (E, 13s CD rank1) sets up the burst; Rite of the Arcane (R) is a global-range channel.

audit.whatIsWrong: champ-data/_kits/_missing/maokai_sup.json flags a genuine unstated interaction: Rite of the Arcane (R) is an interruptible channel, and Twisted Advance (W) or Nature's Grasp (R) cancels it outright. Nothing in the current page mentions this.
audit.why: Xerath's R flags 'channel: interruptible — any CC cancels it'. Maokai's W lands a hard root and R is hard CC too, so catching him mid-cast is a real counterplay the page never states.
audit.corrected: Added the interrupt to phases[4].why (Level 6) as the counterplay to his execute-range ult.

edits.before: Sapling the brush — the lane's hedges are yours now; trades start with a tree's consent.
edits.after: Arcanopulse (Q) hits from beyond your entire kit's range and chips you and your ADC for free before you can threaten CS.

edits.before: W threat begins: the point-click root governs their carry's spacing.
edits.after: A second point lets him zone your ADC off the wave outright — his Q poke chips you down while you still can't close the distance.

edits.before: Full kit: E-zone the trades, W the commits, Q the disengage — the swamp votes.
edits.after: Shocking Orb's 13-second cooldown stun sets up the full Q-W burst — a whiffed W into his E leaves you stunned and deleted.

edits.before: Sustain the margins with passive heals and sapling chip — attrition is a tree's game.
edits.after: His max range keeps you permanently zoned off the wave — Sap Magic sustain can't outpace poke you never get to trade back into.

edits.before: Nature's Grasp online — the root wave starts fights from fog and ends dives in it.
edits.after: Rite of the Arcane chains stuns and bursts your carry once your W lands — but it's a channel, so catching him mid-cast with Twisted Advance or Nature's Grasp cancels it outright.

edits.before: First item: the roots chain and the saplings tax every brush.
edits.after: Post-Lost Chapter his Q-W slow-stun combo punishes any dash and keeps you zoned off the wave every trade.

edits.before: Late Maokai is the engage forest: R the formation, W the carry, and Q whatever the roots deliver.
edits.after: He one-shots your backline from off-screen — only a hidden flank W or a long R that catches his cast before it starts gives you a way in.

edits.before: - Xerath Shocking Orb (Stun): matchup-defining — His only CC — dodge the orb and the artillery never converts. It writes your spacing rules. - Q Bramble Smash is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Xerath Shocking Orb (E): 13s at rank 1, down to 11s at rank 5 — his only CC; dodge it and the artillery combo never converts for the full cooldown. - Q Bramble Smash is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Engage the instant Shocking Orb misses — its 13-second rank-1 cooldown is your only safe entry before his stun chains the burst.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.
edits.after: Stepping into his E range while it's up — the stun into Q-W combo deletes you before your W ever closes the gap.
